scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof with reproducible independent integer finite enumeration. This is not a claim of independent validation, historical priority, or publication.
scientific_limitations: Only {0,1}-valued indicators on elementary abelian two-groups, exact indexed Fourier intensities, support cardinality at most six. Classical (16,6,2) difference sets and the autocorrelation identity are prior; possible older homometry classifications remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp six-point threshold for binary Fourier intensity ambiguity
